cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: VC10 · Testing & E2E Verification · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Verify the user journey and negative cases against real persisted behavior.
cover.alt_text: A persistent record remains inside a refresh ring while a separate access boundary represents testing another user’s permissions.
cover.extended_description:
Verify the user journey and negative cases against real persisted behavior.

A browser test creates a task and sees it in memory, but never reloads. Add a reload and verify the saved task through the real backend, then test that a second user cannot edit it. Record skipped tests as unverified.

A mocked or memory-only pass is not production evidence. Skipped checks remain unverified.
